posts.kicker: THE CRACK IS NOW A CRATER
posts.headline: Put it in Ra just fell to 0-2 and this is no longer a slump, One Nut Barner — it's a full-blown pedigree collapse for a franchise that came in at a league-best 20-8 and 1.5 average finish.
posts.detail: Seven straight editions of me hammering this and Put it in Ra has done nothing but confirm it — 0-2 with 238.06 points is not what a supposed contender's résumé is supposed to look like two weeks into the season.

posts.kicker: BALD FRAUD, WEEK 2: STILL NO FRAUD
posts.headline: tristanthepiston is 2-0 and 286.56 points deep, and the Mexican Bald Fraud nickname is starting to look like false advertising.
posts.detail: A team with a modest 7-7 career mark and a 7th-place average finish has no business being one of only three unbeaten squads in the league — yet here we are, and the numbers don't lie.

posts.headline: Sasinci finally won a game, but don't let the 1-1 record fool you — Big Head's title banner is still gathering dust on a 13-15 career record.
posts.detail: 245.38 points for the season is nothing to celebrate, and after seven straight editions of doubt, one bounce-back week against a rough start doesn't erase the pattern.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is 0-2 with a league-worst 196.8 points on the season, and the Ultimate Light Skin's judgment day just got extended for a sixth straight edition.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career mark was already shaky, and starting 0-2 while bottoming out the scoreboard is exactly the kind of plague this column was built to chronicle.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 2-0 with a league-high 344.18 points and nobody in this league is talking about it like they should be.
posts.detail: A middling 6-7-1 career record and 5th-place average finish did not predict this — triciagloston is outscoring the entire league by nearly 50 points and it's time this gets the respect it deserves.
